self.created = True
        try:
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(self.token)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
evidence.reason: In `Hold.acquire`, the marker file is created with `O_CREAT|O_EXCL` and only the token file is fsynced. There is no `fsync` on the marker directory after creation, so the directory entry is not durably persisted; a power loss after the host switch can lose the admission hold despite the code treating the token as persisted. The same durability gap applies to the unsynced unlink on release, which can leave a stale hold. This is an existing crash-consistency defect in the admission marker semantics, not a new requirement.
